events.name: bp_de_redirect
events.desc: Number of times an early redirect is sent to branch predictor. This happens when either the decoder or dispatch logic is able to detect that the branch predictor needs to be redirected.

events.name: bp_dyn_ind_pred
events.desc: Dynamic indirect predictions (branch used the indirect predictor to make a prediction).

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_fetch_hit.all

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_fetch_hit.if4k

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_hit

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.coalesced_4k

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.if1g
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks are requested) for 1G pages.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.if2m
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks are requested) for 2M pages.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.if4k
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks are requested) for 4k pages.

events.name: bp_l2_btb_correct
